description: This file defines a Java interface 'Command' which serves as a base for all command types understood by Ditto. It includes method signatures, an enum for categories, and a nested class with common JSON field definitions. It acts as a common contract for command objects in the project.

classes.name: Command.Category
classes.description: An enum to categorize commands into QUERY, MODIFY, or DELETE based on their effect.

classes.name: Command.JsonFields
classes.description: An abstract class holding common JSON field definitions for commands, including 'command' and 'type' fields.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix of the command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version the command implements, falling back to the latest if not set.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the command to a JSON object including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (with parameters)
methods.description: Converts the command to a JSON object with a specific schema version and predicate filtering.
